submodules.title: Submodules
submodules.addHint: Declared over SSH in the .gitmodules of the environment's branch.
submodules.searchHint: GitHub account and organizations, forks included.
submodules.hidden: Not visible to the app (e.g. fork of a private repo). Continue with:
submodules.branchHint: Written to .gitmodules; Update uses its latest commit.
submodules.pathHint: Relative to the repository. owner/name by default.
submodules.byHand: GitHub does not let the app write to the repository. Run this in your copy, on {{branch}}, then synchronize:
submodules.empty: No submodules in the last synchronization.
submodules.resynced: Keys in step: {{renewed}} renewed, {{pruned}} orphans removed
submodules.resyncUpToDate: All {{count}} keys were already in step
submodules.resyncFailed: Some keys could not be installed in GitHub

onGitHubHint.removed: The branch no longer declares it. It stays on the server until the next deployment; "Update all" takes it out.
onGitHubHint.added: The branch declares it and it is not on the server yet. "Update all" brings it in.

submodules.updateAllHint: Moves every submodule to the latest commit of its branch in a single commit on {{branch}} and deploys this environment.
submodules.upToDate: All up to date: no submodule has new commits.
submodules.confirmTitle: This will be deployed to this environment
submodules.confirmProduction: This will be deployed to production
submodules.commitNote: A commit will be made on {{branch}} and deployed with a backup first and modules updated.
submodules.behindNote: No submodule has new commits, but the environment does not have what {{branch}} pins: it will be deployed without a commit.
submodules.productionNote: If you can, try it in development first.
submodules.busy: Deployment in progress. The buttons come back when it ends.
submodules.removeConfirm: A commit will remove it from .gitmodules.
submodules.needsAccount: Private, no access for the connected account. Grant read access and synchronize.
submodules.projectKeyMissing: The project's deploy key is not on its repository. Public repositories will be read with the token.
submodules.keyPending: Deploy key pending on the repository
submodules.installRefused: GitHub does not let the app install it. Add it in Deploy keys and look up again.
submodules.addAfterKey: Add submodule is enabled once the key is installed.
